summary: Long over-the-shoulder two-shot at the dining table: the host stalls while smoke drifts in, excuses himself, slips through the kitchen door onto a fire glow, then comes back out faking a yawn and stretch to end the lunch.
framing: Medium two-shot from behind the guest's right shoulder, eye level, looking across the round table at the host with the kitchen door behind him. Static until 2957; at 2958-2965 the camera tilts up about 7% of frame height (picture content slides down: the fruit painting at top left comes fully into frame, the table drops to the bottom edge) to hold the host as he stands. Static again from 2966 to the end.

notes: No cut inside the shot despite two decomp numbers; it is one continuous take. Camera: the measured move (2958-2965, vertical only, about -0.07) matches what is drawn; described here as a tilt up because the content moves down in frame. Dialogue check: the host's mouth is already moving at 2788-2805, well before the first host word in script.json (L42 at 2823); the audio there is probably a stammer the aligner did not catch. The guest never changes pose apart from the two burger bites (2998-3008, 3112-3122) and the burger pull-back at 2982; his face is visible only as a sliver of profile. Smoke is subtle: thin semi-transparent wisps rising beside the door, not a cloud. While the door is closed at 3004-3027 there is no glow at all; after the host returns the door leaks a glow line along its top edge. The host is tinted by the fire only while he stands in the doorway (3032-3040).
